sio2_melting_2.name: Melting of SiO2 - Level 2
sio2_melting_2.description: Simulate the melting of SiO2 by heating under NPT conditions using the Tersoff potential. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Use the partial radial distribution function (RDF) to determine the Si–O bond length after melting. Report the bond length corresponding to the first RDF peak in Å.
